title: Enhancer Dynamics for Gene Regulation in the Cardiovascular System.
one_liner_zh: 综述心血管增强子动态调控，涉及TF结合与机器学习技术，但非核心TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Enhancers are regulatory DNA sequences that increase the transcription of a target gene when bound by transcription factors. Decades of research endeavors have shed light on the crucial roles of enhancers in cardiovascular development and disease. Besides working as cis-regulatory elements, enhancers also play critical roles in transactivating mechanisms such as enhancer RNA transcription and transcriptional condensates. Technological advances, such as single-cell multiomics, CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats)-based enhancer perturbation screens, and machine learning technologies, provide us with unprecedented opportunities to gain novel insights into the dynamic function of cardiovascular enhancers. In this brief review, we discuss cutting-edge techniques that are being or can be leveraged to fill knowledge gaps in studying cardiovascular enhancers. Like gene expression, enhancers display functional dynamics in concordance with specific cellular stress. We summarize the findings of inducible enhancer functions in the cardiovascular system. We also discuss several recent studies that are advancing our understanding of cardiovascular enhancer functions and are potentially paradigm-shifting. These insights have great potential to inform novel therapeutic strategies targeting enhancer-mediated gene dysregulation in cardiovascular disease.
abstract_zh: 增强子（enhancers）是调控性DNA序列，当被转录因子结合时，能增加目标基因的转录。数十年的研究努力已揭示了增强子在心血管发育和疾病中的关键作用。除了作为顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements）发挥作用外，增强子还在反式激活机制中扮演重要角色，如增强子RNA转录（enhancer RNA transcription）和转录凝聚体（transcriptional condensates）。技术进步，如单细胞多组学（single-cell multiomics）、基于CRISPR（成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列）的增强子扰动筛选（CRISPR-based enhancer perturbation screens）以及机器学习技术，为我们提供了前所未有的机会，以获取对心血管增强子动态功能的新见解。在这篇简要综述中，我们讨论了正在或可用于填补心血管增强子研究知识空白的尖端技术。与基因表达类似，增强子表现出与特定细胞应激相一致的功能动态。我们总结了心血管系统中诱导型增强子功能的研究发现。我们还讨论了几项近期研究，这些研究正在推进我们对心血管增强子功能的理解，并可能具有范式转变的意义。这些见解具有巨大潜力，可为针对心血管疾病中增强子介导的基因失调的新型治疗策略提供信息。
